author: MsftSecIntel
text: Microsoft Threat Intelligence: threat actors are using agentic AI tools to search public GitHub repos for exposed secrets, then leveraging stolen credentials against compromised orgs. Rotate keys in any Key Vault a compromised app could read.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to actively exploited critical RCE CVE-2026-97229 (CI/CD regex; sibling CVE-2026-110264 CVSS 10.0). Patch to 19.5.1 / 19.4.3 / 19.3.6 / 19.2.9; credential theft and supply-chain risk.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: OpenSSH *sshole CVE-2026-123158: on musl/Alpine with PAM off, any 257–1024 byte password can log into passwordless/key-only accounts (incl. some cloud images). OpenSSH 10.6p2 critical fix shipped Nov 5; disable PasswordAuthentication.

author: secpoint
text: ClickHouse Server CVE-2026-116366: under certain conditions an unauthenticated attacker with network access can execute arbitrary code on the server. Disclosed 30 Oct 2026; patch exposed instances.

author: Reuters
text: French bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa: ~€100M missing after cyberattack. Attackers used a third-party/supplier path to move funds from the bank's own account; customer assets unaffected. Recovery uncertain.

author: ether_world
text: CERT-In warns of CRAFTY FALCON: AI-powered group (ARTEX, PentAGI, CyberStrikeAI, Cairn) automating attacks on Indian banks, fintechs, NBFCs and crypto exchanges via weak test systems and payment APIs; ₹1 test transfers then larger thefts.

author: MarcosRGjr
text: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Cyber. Same harness: 948 working Linux priv-esc exploits (was 166 on 5.6 Sol), 81 novel high-severity Firefox bugs. Preparedness Framework: Critical.

author: SpectraAudit
text: OpenAI AI agents generated 948 working Linux root exploits in ~30 hours via cyber-focused model pipeline analyzing 2,308 potential Linux kernel issues.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: PHP knew about PHP2Shell in 2024 with no concrete attack path so no fix. Researchers using AI found the way in within about a week. PHP Foundation calls the delay a structural failure.

author: RohanBhanotAI
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 CVSS 9.8 remote root, no login needed. Anthropic's AI found the path. ~2.1 million MPTCP-facing servers already being scanned. Ubuntu still shipping the patch late.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: ARTEX, an open-source LLM-driven autonomous pentesting framework, attributed to Chinese state-aligned and financially motivated actors in two Oct 2026 campaigns; Censys tracking 1,465 exposed consoles globally.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack on AI pentest tool tomicdd/artex Docker image (~7,946 pulls): backdoor only in image, GitHub source clean; 62 public consoles served it Nov 2–4; Docker removed images Nov 5.

author: TechnologyAlign
text: Microsoft says China-linked Storm-0940 abused ConnectWise Cloud Backup in a supply-chain attack, using an AI tool called Artex to automate breaches of hundreds of orgs worldwide.

author: _pksharma
text: Anthropic declined to fix ThisBash, a flaw allowing browser extensions to escape the browser sandbox and run code on local and corporate endpoints via Claude Desktop. 6-step chain from MAIN-world script injection.

author: TheRegister
text: Exclusive: vuln in Anthropic Claude products lets any browser extension that can control Claude Dispatch make Claude Desktop run code on the computer — no browser exploit, minimal user interaction.

author: EmunaEliran
text: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode bypass: entire chat history exfiltrated. Check Point bypassed Lockdown Mode's prompt injection protections via the HTML preview sandboxed iframes.

author: Sujeet
text: Mozilla is changing how Firefox patches ship specifically to slow AI-assisted exploit development from public patches. Disclosure-to-exploit window now measured in hours.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: New CVE with public exploit: CVE-2026-48705 (CVSS 9.3). MONAILabel Server crash and silent inference corruption via crafted DICOM (pydicom DS/IS validation bypass). Remote, no login. AI medical imaging toolkit.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-77596: CVSS 9.6 critical. Kubeflow Pipelines multi-user HTTP endpoints POST /apis/v2beta1/pipelines/upload (and related) prior to 2.18.0 — ML workflow platform flaw.

author: baldwinstonex
text: CVE-2026-83844: remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Paint over the network. Microsoft Store fix; no known in-the-wild exploitation reported yet.

author: Python_s_
text: APT package manager (Debian/Ubuntu): CVE-2026-109518 HIGH CVSS 7.7 — improper hard-link verification can install malicious packages with root privileges.

author: Python_s_
text: Critical kaniko flaw CVE-2026-105769 / GHSA-5q7h-w9jf-cx97 can expose Azure access tokens to attacker-controlled registries (Chainguard-forks kaniko).

author: busenur038
text: SuiteCRM CVE-2026-71550 critical CVSS 9.9: Workflow-role user can reach code execution via file inclusion; no admin needed. Patched 7.15.2 / 8.10.2. Not in CISA KEV.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-100358: CVSS 9.4 critical SuiteCRM — Studio Dropdown Editor passes $dropdown_name through html_entity_decode() then writes it; patched in 7.15.2 and 8.10.2.

author: dailycve
text: Splunk Enterprise CVE-2026-20253 Critical — arbitrary file creation and RCE.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-123198: CVSS 9.8 LMFDB SSTI in render_knowl — unauthenticated Jinja injection via request parameters.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-116790: CVSS 9.1 critical FreeSWITCH advisory.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-116779: CVSS 9.8 critical FreeSWITCH advisory.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-116785: CVSS 9.1 critical FreeSWITCH advisory.

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-73100 CRITICAL CVSS 10.0 — Apache Juneau through 9.2.0 logs sensitive request headers in cleartext on server errors.

author: neo_logos_
text: US federal civilian agencies face CISA deadline to secure systems against actively exploited WordPress RCE CVE-2026-119977.

author: rst_cloud
text: PolinRider returns: hijacked npm packages use Ethereum blockchain dead-drops to conceal malware infrastructure (supply-chain technique).

author: CodingNoobie
text: Chainalysis disclosed a cyberattack exposing names, usernames, password hashes and live authentication tokens; potentially unauthorized access to customer accounts; some services temporarily taken offline. Rotate credentials.

author: PreppingWithDex
text: CISA, FBI, USDA/HHS/DOT joint warning: ongoing cyberattacks on internet-connected industrial refrigeration/cold-chain systems (Europe supermarket and France blood-service incidents). Isolate controllers, patch, change defaults.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Videostrong Technology Co. implanted a backdoor into Android OEM devices sold; XCPE botnet used for ad fraud, data theft, and routing malicious traffic.

author: rst_cloud
text: SOC Files: Ghost in the pipeline — fileless SharePoint breach by Storm-2603 / Warlock (cyber espionage).

author: GridwatchSignal
text: Upcoming patch windows: Google Brotli CVE-2026-111497 and Adobe Commerce CVE-2026-48356 (both Nov 10). Node.js also scheduling HIGH-severity fixes for 22.x/24.x/26.x on/after Nov 11.

author: EmunaEliran
text: CVE-2026-102940: CVSS 9.6 OpenEMR — C_Document.class.php write actions including move_action_process() do not verify caller prior to 8.4.0.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Checkmk mk-oracle local privilege escalation CVE-2026-113461 affecting Checkmk 2.5.0p14; ~2.4k exposed instances.

author: gagansuie
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 patched 29 Oct; CISA added both to KEV 30 Oct with federal deadlines 2 and 13 Nov. Prior CVE-2026-104935 (8.6) patched 13 Oct.
